item.title: Sunday forecast: Sunny, breezy and highs in the 60s

item.title: Chicago dance students attacked with liquid outside studio in alleged racist incident
item.description: A group of Ballet Folklorico de Chicago dancers experienced physical aggression from neighbors who threw an unknown liquid at them while making threats, leading the studio to plan to file a protective order and press charges.
